svg.title: Known events, simultaneous input events, and fixed communication steps
svg.desc: A known event at 1.5 seconds caps a factor-three participant's request before stepping. When the source publishes its output after the first update, both FMUs stay in Event Mode and the target sees it at the next super-dense instant. A fixed-step peer first requested to advance 0.4 seconds rejects a later 0.3-second request.
svg.text: Known event: cap before stepping, no restore
Base 1 s; a factor-three Event Mode participant advertises an event at 1.5 s.
0 to 1.5, handle event, then 1.5 to 3. Execution advances 0, 1, 1.5, 2 s.
A known event caps the request before any speculative overshoot.
Simultaneous ordinary input events: same physical time
Source A has input 2 and changes its output in UpdateDiscreteStates. Target B initially has input 1.
A updates with 2; B updates with 1; stage A's output
Apply A's output to B; A and B both update with 2
B ends with output 2. Both FMUs stay in Event Mode across the two updates.
Both updates occur at the same physical time.
Fixed communication-step peer: shortened first request sets its size
0 to 0.4 s succeeds -> later 0.3 s request is rejected before the next peer step.
After rejection, restore an earlier complete snapshot or recreate the execution.
